sources.title: ONS UK Environmental Accounts: 2026 bulletin
facts: Official public source reviewed: ONS UK Environmental Accounts: 2026 bulletin.
Residence-basis UK GHG emissions were estimated at 478 MtCO2e in 2024; direct energy use was 165.4 Mtoe.
Residence-basis national environmental accounts; not parcel measurement.

sources.title: ONS Environmental accounts topic page
facts: Official public source reviewed: ONS Environmental accounts topic page.
The topic page highlights 2024 residence-basis emissions intensity of 140 tonnes CO2e per £1 million GVA and environmental-account datasets.
Topic/collection page; not parcel measurement.

sources.title: ONS UK Environmental Accounts: 2026 release and datasets
facts: Official public source reviewed: ONS UK Environmental Accounts: 2026 release and datasets.
The release enumerates atmospheric-emissions and energy-use datasets covering 1990 to 2024.
Release index across datasets; dataset scope must be preserved.

sources.title: ONS Measuring UK greenhouse gas emissions
facts: Official public source reviewed: ONS Measuring UK greenhouse gas emissions.
ONS distinguishes territorial, residence/production and footprint/consumption measures; 2025 territorial emissions were estimated at 367 MtCO2e.
Methodology/basis comparison; accounting bases are not interchangeable.

sources.title: ONS Energy use: total — current edition
facts: Official public source reviewed: ONS Energy use: total — current edition.
Dataset covers UK direct energy use by fossil and other sources and industry from 1990 to 2024.
Energy activity data; not direct GHG measurement.

sources.title: ONS Energy use: renewable and waste sources — current edition
facts: Official public source reviewed: ONS Energy use: renewable and waste sources — current edition.
Dataset covers renewable and waste energy use by source and industry from 1990 to 2024.
Energy-use activity; avoided emissions must not be inferred.

sources.title: ONS Energy use: renewable and waste sources dataset
facts: Official public source reviewed: ONS Energy use: renewable and waste sources dataset.
Current dataset edition is published with previous versions retained for revision history.
Dataset landing/revision context; not parcel measurement.

sources.title: ONS Environment, climate and nature insights, UK: 2026
facts: Official public source reviewed: ONS Environment, climate and nature insights, UK: 2026.
The article reports residence-basis GHG intensity fell 72% between 1990 and 2024, from 500 to 140 tonnes CO2e per £1m GVA.
Cross-source analytical overview; source measures retain original bases.

sources.title: ONS Atmospheric emissions: greenhouse gases by industry and gas
facts: Official public source reviewed: ONS Atmospheric emissions: greenhouse gases by industry and gas.
Dataset covers CO2, CH4, N2O, HFCs, PFCs, SF6, NF3 and total GHG by around 130 SIC groups for 1990 to 2024.
Industry/residence-account data; current and provisional editions differ.

sources.title: ONS Energy use: total dataset
facts: Official public source reviewed: ONS Energy use: total dataset.
Dataset covers direct and reallocated energy use by industry for 1990 to 2024.
Energy-use dataset; not a parcel emissions observation.

sources.title: ONS Energy use: fossil fuels by fuel type
facts: Official public source reviewed: ONS Energy use: fossil fuels by fuel type.
Dataset covers coal, natural gas, petrol, DERV, fuel oil, gas oil, aviation fuel and other fossil fuel use from 1990 to 2024.
Fuel-use activity; excludes biofuels and waste.

sources.title: DESNZ Final UK greenhouse gas emissions statistics: 1990 to 2024
facts: Official public source reviewed: DESNZ Final UK greenhouse gas emissions statistics: 1990 to 2024.
Final territorial GHG statistics allocate emissions across electricity, fuel supply, domestic transport, buildings/product uses, industry, agriculture, waste and LULUCF.
Final territorial inventory; not consumption or residence basis.
